name: Diaper Field
desc: The small-scale seme field of Gothic illumination -- a raised gilt trellis of lozenges with a motif (fleur-de-lis, cross-crosslet, rose or quatrefoil) stamped in every cell on a jewel ground; the lattice is fixed but a soft pool of light drifts across it on incommensurate rates, so the gilding gleams cell by cell and deepens to shadow behind, and the strict symmetry never reads frozen, rendered as illuminated gilt, incised stone grisaille, tin-glazed majolica, or a cyan schematic.

energy.doc: brightness of the drifting light pool and gilt gleam

scale.doc: cell size of the diaper -- larger cells, fewer, bolder

speed.doc: how fast the pool of light drifts across the field

density.doc: number of trellis cells across the frame

motif.doc: the charge stamped in every cell

style.doc: aesthetic: illuminated gilt on jewel ground / incised stone grisaille / tin-glazed majolica / cyan schematic lattice

seed.doc: deterministic -- re-throws ground grain and ground tint
